newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas softens in near months, untraded later.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas softens in near months, untraded later.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market traded 135 lots in 10 separate transactions on Wednesday, with the tone softer in the near months.

Although there was no trade in front month April, May traded down by 0.060 pence a therm to close at 10.00 pence. June was off by 0.10 pence to trade last at 10.10 pence, while July traded slightly higher.
As a result of these price readjustments, the contract is now in contango, at least on the basis of bids and offers, from April through to February 1998.
